content.name: Tobias Krämer
content.title: Lead UX Designer
content.summary: Lead UX designer with 14 years in enterprise software, mobility and insurance in München. Leads a design team of seven, introduced a company-wide design system, and prepared the customer portal for the Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz; the redesigned claims journey reduced handling time by 22%.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Designed interfaces for a production planning suite used by about 200 manufacturing customers.
Ran usability tests on shop-floor terminals, which led to larger touch targets and a simplified shift overview.
Wrote the first UX guidelines for the product, adopted by three development teams.

experience.title: Senior UX Designer
bullets: Led UX for a car-sharing and charging app across Germany and Austria, growing to 350,000 active users.
Designed the charging-session flow with field tests at 30 charging stations, reducing failed starts by 18%.
Built a research panel of 500 users and ran monthly testing rounds with product managers.
Mentored four designers and introduced design reviews into the sprint process.

experience.title: Lead UX Designer
bullets: Lead a team of seven UX and UI designers and researchers across the customer portal, claims and broker tools.
Introduced a design system shared by 12 development teams, with tokens, components and documentation in German and English.
Redesigned the claims journey with the claims department, reducing average handling time by 22%.
Prepared the customer portal for the Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG) by auditing against EN 301 549 and fixing priority issues before June 2025.
Own a design budget of €600,000 a year for research, tools and external support.

education.details: Thesis on touch interaction in industrial settings

courses.name: CPUX-F (Certified Professional for Usability and User Experience)

achievements.title: Design system rollout
achievements.detail: Took the design system from pilot to all 12 teams in 18 months.

achievements.title: Speaker
achievements.detail: Talk on accessible insurance forms at a German UX conference in 2024.
